en: Listen. Do you hear it ticking? Every lock in five regions keeps time with this machine.
I made clocks for the harbour once. A clock never leaves, never tires, never chooses another.
So I made hearts like clocks. Perfectly loyal partners. Never afraid of losing anyone again.
My own Ampharos was the first. It hasn't left my side in years. Let me show you what loyalty is.
It stopped. It actually stopped. And my Ampharos is looking at you as if you were the clockmaker.
...Perhaps a heart was never meant to keep time.
Juno is still on the floor below. Nobody comes up these stairs without her say.
The machine is quiet. Keld came quietly too, in the end. My bureau will see to the rest.
Every heart you took back will open in time, beside you. That is the one thing no machine can do.
If any of them were sent back to Lockwork's crates before you could reach them, they will turn up again. Looker is sure of it.
